# Pure-Python copies of everything server.py needs on STRATO, so the site does not depend on
# packages installed on the web server. Same Flask and Werkzeug versions as ../../requirements.txt.
# cgi_app.py puts this folder first on sys.path, ahead of any globally installed Flask.
#
# To refresh: download these wheels (pip download --no-deps), unzip the package folders and the
# *.dist-info licence files here. MarkupSafe comes from the source archive without _speedups.c:
# it then uses its built-in pure-Python version, which works on any CPU.
flask==3.1.1
werkzeug==3.1.3
jinja2==3.1.6
markupsafe==3.0.2
itsdangerous==2.2.0
click==8.1.8
blinker==1.9.0
pymysql==1.1.1
